runtime.application_data: one or more existing MySQL software-source databases, read directly
runtime.control_plane: data/control JSON files; encrypted source credentials; no PostgreSQL runtime dependency
runtime.ipa_storage: original URLs from fa_category.bt1a; no duplicate upload

notes: 1207 production/runtime baseline remains the last real BaoTa verification.
Existing PostgreSQL settings may remain in .env only for rollback compatibility; 1208 runtime code does not connect to PostgreSQL.
Installer never auto-stops or uninstalls a system PostgreSQL service because other sites may depend on it.
External MySQL software-source databases are not modified by updates. Download counter write-back is opt-in per source.
